execution.promptDeclined: Shown when the person closes the prompt for variable values without answering.
execution.unusableAddress: Error shown when a script calls sendRequest with an address that is empty or unusable.
execution.sendLimit: {{limit}} is a number, the most calls a single script may make. sendRequest is a function name; keep it unchanged.
execution.hostNotPermitted: {{host}} is a host name such as api.example.com.
execution.scriptFileReads: {{example}} is the placeholder syntax for reading a file and must stay unchanged.
execution.preRequest: Name of the script stage that runs before a request is sent. Appears in the timeline and in check results.
execution.postResponse: Name of the script stage that runs after a response arrives. Appears in the timeline and in check results.
execution.scopeLabel: A script stage followed by the folder or collection it comes from, for example Pre-request script (Payments). {{stage}} is one of the two stage names, {{name}} is a folder or collection name.
execution.restricted: Shown when something in an untrusted workspace folder needs scripts, OAuth, local commands or file reads. Trust this folder is the name of the menu item.
